## Summary

Describe the approved change and link the maintainer-approved issue.

## Validation

- [ ] I have permission to submit this contribution and to include its code/assets.
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE.md and SECURITY.md.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior; validation results and limitations are included.
- [ ] No secrets, private transcripts, recordings, user exports or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] No production migrations, destructive scripts or live-account tests run without explicit authorization.
- [ ] Changes to providers, personal-data flows or paid-service usage are documented.

## Test results and deployment notes

List commands run, required configuration and any checks not performed.
